## Body

PR #241 final security verdict at d3ea172cf60b9c18ab463651006555e6ba8cb4f7 is pass-with-notes. The daemon status client, not only the sidecar upstream client, must disable redirects: crates/daemon/src/cache_proxy.rs:382-425 uses Policy::none and refuses non-2xx; cache_proxy_tests.rs:278-317 checks plain/no provider wiring and zero redirect-destination hits.

Native /new route inheritance must follow verified host incarnation/pane and stored predecessor resolution, never a seat identifier alone. The admission/predecessor chain is registration.rs:505-614,692-844,998-1065,1753-1794; the route-copy decision is :1145-1167. The HTTP/SQLite rollover regression in http/native_tests.rs:3151-3294,3430-3463 covers proxied S1-to-S2 and opted-out S2-to-S3. This is registration-strength observation under C33, not same-user process authentication.

Retain the accepted qualifications: startup PIJ_CACHE_PROXY_URL is trusted configuration and its prefix check is not general parsed-host validation; status reason/fix strings are not arbitrary-secret scrubbing. No remaining in-scope exploit was established. CI run 44235226491 passed for source head d3ea172c, testing synthetic merge a569de6f2649eddf608b195d04ecab339d50ee0e; successful job 134569619430's artifact 14396524204 records both regressions passing, 2494 cases and zero failures/errors/skips. Author mutation/live receipts were inspected, not reproduced; no local build or harness gate was run under the packet's CI-only instruction.

Harness feedback: pij send --help advertised --body but the shim refused unknown send flag --body; native pij-rs send --to ... --body ... worked. Observation DL-001 is in the pij-overall-mammal buffer. Magic wand: exercise help-advertised send flags against the shim in the native-forwarding contract test, so help and execution cannot silently diverge. This review stayed read-only; the test improvement remains owned implementation work, not a claimed fix.
